name: auspex-launch-film
description: AuspeX launch film: Remotion, Amazon Polly narration, a synthesised score, real captures of the live deployment

scripts.vo: node scripts/vo.mjs && node scripts/align.mjs && node scripts/timeline.mjs && bash scripts/vo-level.sh
scripts.render: npm run verify && remotion render AuspexFilm out/auspex-raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --concurrency=8 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k && bash scripts/master.sh
